description: This file defines an abstract class 'BrowserType' for managing browser launching, connection, and process handling within the Playwright project. It includes methods for launching browsers, handling processes, and managing transport connections, with project-specific logic and error handling.

classes.name: BrowserType
classes.description: An abstract class representing a browser type, providing methods for launching, connecting, and managing browser processes and transports within the Playwright framework.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Returns the executable path for the browser type from the registry.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the browser type.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a browser instance with specified options, handling retries and startup errors.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Launches a persistent browser context with specified options, including handling client certificates.

methods.name: _innerLaunchWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to launch a browser with retries in case of specific errors.

methods.name: _innerLaunch
methods.description: Handles the core logic of launching a browser process, establishing transport, and error handling.

methods.name: _prepareToLaunch
methods.description: Prepares command-line arguments, user data directories, and executable paths for launching.

methods.name: _launchProcess
methods.description: Starts the browser process, manages process signals, and establishes communication transport.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to a browser over Chrome DevTools Protocol (not supported for non-Chromium).

methods.name: connectOverCDPTransport
methods.description: Connects to a browser over an existing transport (not supported for non-Chromium).

methods.name: _launchWithSeleniumHub
methods.description: Launches a browser via Selenium Hub (not supported for non-Chromium).

methods.name: _validateLaunchOptions
methods.description: Validates and adjusts launch options based on environment and flags.

methods.name: _createUserDataDirArgMisuseError
methods.description: Generates an error message for incorrect userDataDir argument usage based on SDK language.

methods.name: _rewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites protocol error logs for better readability.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready, default implementation returns empty object.

methods.name: prepareUserDataDir
methods.description: Prepares the user data directory before launching.

methods.name: supportsPipeTransport
methods.description: Indicates whether pipe transport is supported (default true).

methods.name: getExecutableName
methods.description: Returns the executable name based on options or default.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Abstract method to get default launch arguments for the browser.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Abstract method to connect to a browser transport.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Abstract method to amend environment variables for the launch process.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Abstract method to rewrite startup logs.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Abstract method to attempt graceful closure of the browser.
